description: This file contains integration tests for the observability forwarder component within the project. It covers scenarios such as end-to-end webhook delivery, dead letter queue handling, configuration reloading, filtering of heartbeat events, signature verification, batch aggregation, storage persistence, and heartbeat filtering.

methods.name: setupIntegrationTest
methods.description: Creates a real storage instance for integration testing, setting up database paths and initializing storage.

methods.name: TestIntegration_EndToEndWebhookDelivery
methods.description: Tests the full flow from event publishing to webhook delivery, including mock server setup, event publishing, and validation of received data.

methods.name: TestIntegration_DeadLetterQueueFlow
methods.description: Tests the dead letter queue handling by simulating failed webhook delivery, DLQ storage, and redrive process.

methods.name: TestIntegration_ConfigReload
methods.description: Verifies that the forwarder correctly reloads its configuration upon webhook setting changes.

methods.name: TestIntegration_HeartbeatFiltering
methods.description: Ensures heartbeat events are filtered out and not forwarded to the webhook.

methods.name: TestIntegration_SignatureVerification
methods.description: Checks that the signature generated for webhook requests matches expected HMAC signatures.

methods.name: TestIntegration_BatchAggregation
methods.description: Confirms events are batched correctly according to configured batch size and timeout.

methods.name: TestIntegration_StoragePersistence
methods.description: Ensures webhook configurations persist across forwarder restarts and are correctly loaded from storage.
